unidades.unidad_y_contenidos: Unit 1: Family, routine and free time Vocabulary: Family Free time activities Daily routine activities Places in a town and geographical features Grammar: Present simple with adverbs of frequency and time expressions There is/There are + quantifiers Present continuous Be going for future plans and intentions Listening and reading comprehension: Related to the vocabulary and grammar areas Written expression: Daily routine, free time and future plans Oral expression: Communicate ideas using specific grammar when talking Speak about one’s daily routine, free time activities and future plans.

Unit 2: Travel, education and work Vocabulary: Holiday activities Past simple and participles for common irregular verbs Life experiences Future activities Grammar : Past simple with regular and irregular verbs Present perfect with regular verbs for life experiences Expressions with will and won’t for future degrees of certainty Listening and reading comprehension: Related to the vocabulary and grammar areas Written expression: Holidays and travel experiences Education and work Oral expression: Communicate ideas using specific grammar when talking Speak about one’s experiences with travelling, education and make prediction about one’s future employment.
